author: Spector, Ronald H.
title: Eagle Against the Sun: The American War with Japan
notes: The one-volume scholarly history of the American war with Japan, and the best single frame for the arc: strategy, inter-service politics, intelligence and logistics rather than battle narrative, and unsentimental about all of them. Written by a historian who had run the Navy's own history programme, and still the standard survey forty years on. Some catalogues date it 1984; the Free Press hardback recorded in the Internet Archive's cataloguing of the physical book is 1985, which is what is written here. Verified against catalogue records only, not the item; no ISBN is recorded.
